value.rationale: The standard, motivated complete-mean coupled logistic-map model admits sharply different spectral behavior under deterministic cyclic versus synchronous updating. The exact all-population finite-N stability cutoff, universal (N+1) root-of-unity critical resonance, and min-size N=3 logistic stabilization constitute a nontrivial natural structural classification. Existing stochastic-order/nearest-neighbor arguments alone do not supply the sharp theorem.
